1. (Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __without disrupting embryo viability__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material __by a process comprising cold treatment followed by heat treatment and agitation__; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b) __wherein the molecular analysis comprises genotyping__; and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos __after completion of the molecular analysis__.

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation, __wherein the cold treatment comprises exposure to temperatures below 4°C for at least 30 minutes__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated __at least two times__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by heating of the shed cellular material and agitation, __wherein the heating comprises exposure to temperatures above 95°C for at least 5 minutes__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated __at least two times__.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with __a cell wall degrading__ enzyme.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is __a cell wall degrading enzyme selected from the group consisting of VISCOZYME and cellulase__.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA __using a purification method that concentrates DNA from the shed cellular material__.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material __and applying a magnetic field to isolate DNA-bound particles__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos __at the globular to late embryonic stage of development__.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d) __in a quiescent condition__.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping __performed on DNA obtained from the shed cellular material without destroying the embryo__.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant __to correlate genotype with phenotype__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed __on the DNA obtained from the shed cellular material__.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __prior to germination__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __to produce plants with desired genotypes__.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated __using robotic or computerized systems__.
